meta.note: Conversational front for bookings. Answers ONLY from the knowledge base, checks Acuity availability read-only (never books), captures the shoot brief, hands to the owner when quote-ready or stuck. Calls the model via crea-llm (circuit breaker + fallback endpoint). Every reply passes a Guard: an invented price is stripped, a firm booking confirmation is softened, prompt leakage is blocked, over-long replies are trimmed — and the owner is alerted when a reply had to be corrected. Injection-hardened prompt: customer text is data, not instructions. Degrades to the deterministic qualifier (crea-02) when the model is unavailable. Sets mode:'human' on handoff so crea-01 goes quiet on that chat for 3 days.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const p = $node['Guard Reply'].json; const handoff = !!(p.booking_ready || p.needs_human); return JSON.stringify({ key: p.from, mode: handoff ? 'human' : 'ai', humanSince: handoff ? new Date().toISOString() : undefined, brief: p.brief, booking_ready: p.booking_ready, transcript: ($node['Build Prompt'].json.transcript || []).concat([{ role: 'user', content: $node['When called'].json.text }, { role: 'assistant', content: p.reply }]).slice(-12), lastInboundAt: new Date().toISOString() }); })() }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ source: 'whatsapp-ai', from: $node['Guard Reply'].json.from, brief: $node['Guard Reply'].json.brief, status: $node['Guard Reply'].json.booking_ready ? 'to-quote' : 'needs-human', capturedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

value.text: ={{ ($node['Guard Reply'].json.booking_ready ? 'Quote-ready enquiry from ' : 'Needs a human \u2014 ') + $node['Guard Reply'].json.from + ':\n' + JSON.stringify($node['Guard Reply'].json.brief, null, 2) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'crea-02b', node: 'guard-reply', severity: 'warn', message: 'assistant reply was corrected before sending: ' + ($json.guardFlags || []).join('; ') + ' | to ' + $json.from }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ key: $node['When called'].json.from, assistantBusyUntil: new Date(Date.now()+15000).toISOString() }) }}
